_doc: Registry of the standalone audit scripts in this folder, read by run_audits.py (make audits_long).
kind 'guard': a pass/fail regression check for a bug that was fixed; run by default.
kind 'probe': a one-off investigation, measurement or statistical check; listed so it is not mistaken
for a regression, never run by default (run_audits.py --kind probe runs them).
Scripts not listed here (analyse_*, profile_*, measure_*, probe_*, simulate_*, dump_*, render_*,
attribute_*, spawnform_probe_labels, inspect_bgb_state) are investigation tools, not checks.
Two guards are already in make smoke via test_static_map_audits.py and are marked in_smoke.
